112.title: Business Analysis
headers:
Business Analysis Core Concept Model


Core concepts to approach scenarios, problems, opportunities
1. Change - Transformation in response to need; controlled and deliberate
2. Need - Problem or opportunity to be addressed; motivation to act
3. Solution - Way of satisfying needs; resolving problems or enabling opportunities
4. Stakeholder - Group/Individual with a relationship to the change
5. Value - Worth, importance, usefulness to a stakeholder (financial or non-financial)
6. Context - Environment and circumstances influencing the change (culture, tech, market)
